original_ai_output.title_zh: 南苏丹团结州利尔县SPLM-IO敌对派系爆发冲突
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 南苏丹团结州利尔县Rupkong和Bow地区爆发武装冲突，交战双方为反对派SPLM-IO两名自称为代理主席的敌对派系。一名与Oyet阵营结盟的军方专员指控Joseph派系发动袭击，并称冲突造成14人死亡、8人受伤；而Joseph阵营的军方州长则称己方仅3人受伤、无人死亡。双方伤亡数字均无法独立核实。

location.raw_text: Rupkong and Bow payams in Leer County, Unity State

key_facts.fact: 南苏丹团结州利尔县Rupkong和Bow地区爆发SPLM-IO敌对派系武装冲突
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Fighting between forces loyal to rival acting chairpersons of the opposition SPLM-IO erupted in Rupkong and Bow payams in Leer County, Unity State

key_facts.fact: 冲突涉及分别效忠Regina Joseph与Oyet Nathaniel的武装力量
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The clashes involved forces aligned with Regina Joseph and Oyet Nathaniel, both of whom identify themselves as the movement’s acting chairpersons.

key_facts.fact: 与Oyet结盟的军方专员Bading指控Joseph派系袭击其阵地，并称冲突造成14人死亡、8人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Bading said the fighting had killed 14 people from the two sides, including four from his faction and 10 from the opposing group. He added that eight people had been injured

key_facts.fact: 与Joseph结盟的军方州长Koryom称己方3人受伤、无人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Koryom said his side had recorded three injuries and no deaths

key_facts.fact: 双方提供的伤亡数字无法独立核实
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The casualty figures provided by the two officials could not be independently verified.

key_facts.fact: 冲突发生在SPLM-IO领导层危机背景下，其领导人Riek Machar于2025年3月被拘留
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The fighting comes amid a deepening leadership crisis within the SPLM-IO following the detention of its leader, Riek Machar, in March 2025.

uncertainties: 双方伤亡数字存在冲突且无法独立核实
事件为单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
